opportunities.name: Movie night planning: look up movie ratings and draft invite email
opportunities.description: For a given movie, look up it on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a mail message to a friend with the movie's director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer, for a given day.
steps: Search the movie title on IMDb and open its page to read rating, director and runtime
Search the movie title on Rotten Tomatoes and open its page to read the Tomatometer
Open new message in mail and enter the recipient in To
Enter body 'Hi <name>, <day> we watch <movie> (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <rating>, Tomatometer <score>.'

instances.values: Arrival -> lena@example.com, Friday, Denis Villeneuve, 1h 56m, IMDb 7.9, 94%
Spirited Away -> tom@example.com, Saturday, Hayao Miyazaki, 2h 4m, IMDb 8.6, 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel -> aisha@example.com, Sunday, Wes Anderson, 1h 39m, IMDb 8.1, 92%

opportunities.name: npm package research: stats and latest release saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, search npm, open its page, follow the GitHub repo link to Releases, and save a note with version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: Search the package name in npm search and press Enter
Open the exact-match package page; note version, weekly downloads, license
Click the repository link to GitHub
Open Releases; note stars, open issues, last release date
Open Notes, type the summary line and press Enter

opportunities.name: Recipe research: Allrecipes + Wikipedia origin saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, search Allrecipes, open the top recipe, check the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings, rating, time, key ingredients and origin.
steps: Search the dish name on Allrecipes and open the top result
Read rating, time, servings and key ingredients
Search the dish on Wikipedia and read its origin
Open Notes, type '<dish> for <n>: <recipe> (<rating>, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <origin>' and press Enter

instances.values: shakshuka for 4, Chef John's Shakshuka, Ottoman North Africa
pad thai for 2, Pad Thai (4.0 stars, 45 mins), Thailand
